change: A sender can write only when it has calls to send: with CALL_LOG_DEADLINE_SECONDS or CALL_LOG_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS (StorageSink's deadline_seconds and heartbeat_seconds; in JS deadlineSeconds, heartbeatSeconds and flushDue(); the call-log object's vars), each dataset's file goes once its first unsent call has waited the deadline, and a quiet dataset writes its report alone each heartbeat; with neither set, a file every two minutes as before
